natural: Suspecting gods and ghosts everywhere

meaning.en: Paranoid; suspicious of everything.
meaning.zh: 形容疑心重，无中生有地乱猜疑。

examples.zh: 他总是疑神疑鬼，觉得别人在议论他。
examples.en: He's always paranoid that people are talking about him.

examples.zh: 别疑神疑鬼的，没有人跟踪你。
examples.en: Stop being paranoid — nobody's following you.

natural: Handling ten thousand affairs a day

meaning.en: Extremely busy with important affairs (of leaders).
meaning.zh: 每天处理成千上万的事务。形容政务繁忙。

equivalents: have a thousand things to do

examples.zh: 总理日理万机，还抽空来看望大家。
examples.en: The premier is incredibly busy but still found time to visit everyone.

examples.zh: 你日理万机，怎么有空来找我？（戏）
examples.en: A busy person like you — how did you find time to come and see me? (jokingly)

story.en: The minister Gao Yao urged the ruler to be diligent, since "in one day, in two days, there are ten thousand matters" (一日二日万几).
story.zh: 《尚书·皋陶谟》："兢兢业业，一日二日万几。"

usage.en: Predicate. Respectful of leaders; also used jokingly.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于领导，也可戏用。

natural: Turning old age back to childhood

meaning.en: To regain one's youth; to be rejuvenated.
meaning.zh: 由衰老恢复青春。形容老年人充满活力。

examples.zh: 爷爷和孙子一起玩，好像返老还童了。
examples.en: Playing with his grandson, Grandpa seems to have turned back the clock.

examples.zh: 世上没有让人返老还童的药。
examples.en: There's no elixir of youth.

usage.en: Predicate. From Daoist pursuits of immortality.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。源自道家长生之说。

natural: Soaring and trampling over others

meaning.en: Arrogant and domineering; riding roughshod over others.
meaning.zh: 原指意气举动超越常规，不受约束。现多形容骄横放肆。

examples.zh: 他仗着有钱飞扬跋扈。
examples.en: He rides roughshod over everyone because he's rich.

examples.zh: 这个恶霸在村里飞扬跋扈。
examples.en: The bully lords it over the village.

story.en: Du Fu wrote of his friend Li Bai's untamed spirit: "Soaring and unbridled — for whom is this heroism?" (飞扬跋扈为谁雄). The modern sense is negative.
story.zh: 杜甫《赠李白》："痛饮狂歌空度日，飞扬跋扈为谁雄？"原指豪放不羁，现多为贬义。

natural: Bringing in a bushel of gold a day

meaning.en: To rake in money; very lucrative.
meaning.zh: 一天就能收入一斗金子。形容收入多，赚钱快。

examples.zh: 这家网红餐厅日进斗金。
examples.en: The trendy restaurant is raking it in.

examples.zh: 祝您生意兴隆，日进斗金！
examples.en: May your business boom and the money pour in!

usage.en: Predicate. Common in business good wishes.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于生意祝福。

natural: Brothers in misfortune

meaning.en: Fellow sufferers; two people in the same boat. (Originally nán: two brothers equally excellent.)
meaning.zh: 现指彼此曾共患难的人，或同处困境的人。原读 nán，指兄弟都好，难分高下。

examples.zh: 我们俩都被裁员了，真是一对难兄难弟。
examples.en: We were both laid off — real fellow sufferers.

examples.zh: 这两支球队成了联赛中的难兄难弟。
examples.en: The two teams are companions in misery at the bottom of the league.

origin.source: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·德行》

story.en: Asked whose father was better, Chen Ji said: "Yuanfang is hard to rank above as an elder brother, Jifang hard to rank below as a younger brother" (元方难为兄，季方难为弟) — they were equally good.
story.zh: 陈寔说："元方难为兄，季方难为弟。"原指兄弟才德相当。

usage.en: Object. Modern sense (nàn, fellow sufferers) is far more common, often humorous.
usage.zh: 多作宾语。现多用"共患难"义，读 nàn，常带诙谐。

natural: Ahead by one counting stick

meaning.en: Slightly better; a cut above.
meaning.zh: 比较起来稍微好一些。

examples.zh: 两人水平相当，他略胜一筹。
examples.en: They're evenly matched, but he has the edge.

examples.zh: 论设计，这款手机略胜一筹。
examples.en: In design, this phone is a cut above.

usage.en: Predicate. 筹 = counting stick used in scoring.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"筹"为计数用的竹签。

natural: In old age one should be all the more vigorous

meaning.en: Old but still vigorous; age has not diminished one's spirit.
meaning.zh: 年纪虽老，志向更大，劲头更足。

equivalents: no spring chicken but still kicking

examples.zh: 爷爷八十岁了，还天天爬山，真是老当益壮。
examples.en: Grandpa is eighty and still climbs hills daily — going strong.

examples.zh: 这位老教授老当益壮，还在指导研究生。
examples.en: The elderly professor is still going strong, supervising graduate students.

story.en: General Ma Yuan said: "A man's ambition should grow firmer in poverty and stronger in old age" (穷当益坚，老当益壮). He led campaigns into his sixties.
story.zh: 马援说："丈夫为志，穷当益坚，老当益壮。"

natural: The masses rebel and loved ones leave

meaning.en: Deserted by everyone, even one's closest allies.
meaning.zh: 众人反对，亲信背离。形容完全孤立。

examples.zh: 他独断专行，最后众叛亲离。
examples.en: He ruled by decree and ended up deserted by everyone.

examples.zh: 暴君终将众叛亲离。
examples.en: Tyrants will eventually be abandoned by all.

story.en: When Zhouxu usurped the throne of Wey, a minister predicted: "The masses rebel and his kin desert him — he cannot succeed" (众叛亲离，难以济矣).
story.zh: 《左传》："夫州吁阻兵而安忍……众叛亲离，难以济矣。"

natural: A grain of millet in the vast sea

meaning.en: A drop in the ocean; utterly insignificant in comparison.
meaning.zh: 大海里的一粒谷子。比喻非常渺小。

examples.zh: 个人的力量在宇宙中不过是沧海一粟。
examples.en: An individual's strength is but a speck in the universe.

examples.zh: 我知道的只是沧海一粟。
examples.en: What I know is a drop in the ocean.

story.en: Su Shi's Red Cliff Ode: "We lodge like mayflies between heaven and earth, tiny as a grain of millet in the vast sea" (渺沧海之一粟).
story.zh: 苏轼《赤壁赋》："寄蜉蝣于天地，渺沧海之一粟。"

natural: One's name falls below Sun Shan's

meaning.en: To fail an exam.
meaning.zh: 名字落在榜末孙山的后面。指考试或选拔没有被录取。

examples.zh: 他第一次高考名落孙山，第二年考上了。
examples.en: He failed the gaokao the first time but passed the next year.

examples.zh: 这次选拔她名落孙山。
examples.en: She didn't make the cut this time.

story.en: Sun Shan passed the provincial exam in last place. A neighbour asked whether his son had passed. Sun replied: "At the bottom of the list is Sun Shan; your son is beyond Sun Shan."
story.zh: 孙山考中最后一名，同乡问其子是否考中，孙山说："解名尽处是孙山，贤郎更在孙山外。"

usage.en: Predicate. A tactful way to say someone failed.

natural: Turning bends and skirting corners

meaning.en: To beat about the bush; roundabout.
meaning.zh: 沿着弯弯曲曲的路走。比喻说话不直截了当。

examples.zh: 有话直说，别拐弯抹角的。
examples.en: Say what you mean — stop beating about the bush.

examples.zh: 他拐弯抹角地问我借钱。
examples.en: He asked to borrow money in a roundabout way.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Also 转弯抹角.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。也作"转弯抹角"。

natural: Extreme joy gives rise to sorrow

meaning.en: Extreme joy turns to sorrow.
meaning.zh: 快乐到了极点，就会转而发生悲哀的事情。

equivalents: what goes up must come down

examples.zh: 他高兴得跳起来，结果扭了脚，真是乐极生悲。
examples.en: He jumped for joy and twisted his ankle — joy turned to sorrow.

examples.zh: 庆祝时也要注意安全，以免乐极生悲。
examples.en: Stay safe while celebrating, lest joy turn to grief.

story.en: Chunyu Kun warned King Wei of Qi against all-night drinking: "When wine is at its peak there is disorder; when joy is at its peak there is sorrow" (酒极则乱，乐极则悲).
story.zh: 淳于髡劝齐威王："酒极则乱，乐极则悲，万事尽然。"

pinyin: jiě líng hái xū xì líng rén
literal: untie · bell · still · must · tie · bell · person
natural: The one who tied the bell must untie it

meaning.en: Whoever created a problem must solve it.
meaning.zh: 比喻谁惹出来的麻烦，还得由谁去解决。

equivalents: you made this mess, you clean it up
whoever started it has to fix it

examples.zh: 这个矛盾是你引起的，解铃还须系铃人。
examples.en: You caused this conflict, so you'll have to sort it out.

examples.zh: 解铃还须系铃人，你去跟她道个歉吧。
examples.en: You started it — go and apologise to her.

story.en: The Chan master Fayan asked: "Who can untie the golden bell from the tiger's neck?" No one answered, until Taiqin said: "The one who tied it on."
story.zh: 法眼禅师问："虎项金铃，是谁解得？"众人无对，泰钦说："系者解得。"

usage.en: Standalone saying. 系 is xì (to tie).

natural: As close as hands and feet

meaning.en: As close as brothers.
meaning.zh: 交情深厚，如同兄弟一样。

examples.zh: 他们俩从小一起长大，情同手足。
examples.en: They grew up together and are like brothers.

examples.zh: 战友之间情同手足。
examples.en: Comrades-in-arms are as close as family.

usage.zh: 多作谓语。"手足"比喻兄弟。

natural: In the third watch, in the middle of the night

meaning.en: In the middle of the night.
meaning.zh: 指深夜。

equivalents: in the middle of the night

examples.zh: 三更半夜的，谁在敲门？
examples.en: Who's knocking in the middle of the night?

examples.zh: 他经常工作到三更半夜。
examples.en: He often works into the small hours.

usage.en: Adverbial of time. 三更 is the third night-watch, around 11 pm–1 am.
usage.zh: 多作时间状语。"三更"约为晚上十一点至一点。

natural: Dragons soaring and tigers leaping

meaning.en: A scene of great vigour and activity.
meaning.zh: 像龙在飞腾，虎在跳跃。形容动作矫健，或场面热烈。

examples.zh: 运动会上一派龙腾虎跃的景象。
examples.en: The sports day was a scene of tremendous energy.

examples.zh: 新年到，全国上下龙腾虎跃。
examples.en: The New Year has arrived, and the whole country is bursting with energy.

natural: Rare goods worth hoarding

meaning.en: A rare asset to hoard for profit; to exploit something scarce.
meaning.zh: 把少有的货物囤积起来，等待高价出售。比喻凭借某种独特的技能或东西谋取名利。

examples.zh: 他把这项技术当作奇货可居，不肯分享。
examples.en: He treats the technology as a gold mine to sit on and won't share it.

examples.zh: 有人囤积口罩，以为奇货可居。
examples.en: Some hoarded masks, thinking they'd cornered the market.

story.en: The merchant Lü Buwei met the Qin prince Zichu, a neglected hostage in Zhao, and said: "This is a rare commodity worth hoarding." He backed Zichu, who became king, and Lü became chancellor.
story.zh: 吕不韦见到在赵国做人质的秦公子子楚，说"此奇货可居"，后助其登上王位，自己成为丞相。

natural: Speaking without keeping faith

meaning.en: To break one's promises; not keep one's word.
meaning.zh: 说话不讲信用。

examples.zh: 他言而无信，答应的事从来不做。
examples.en: He never keeps his word — he never does what he promises.

examples.zh: 做生意最怕言而无信。
examples.en: In business, breaking promises is the worst thing.

natural: The spirit of the dragon-horse

meaning.en: Vigour and vitality (a greeting, especially for elders).
meaning.zh: 像龙马一样的精神。比喻旺盛的精神。常用作祝福语。

examples.zh: 祝您新年龙马精神，身体健康！
examples.en: Wishing you vigour and good health in the New Year!

examples.zh: 爷爷八十多了，依然龙马精神。
examples.en: Grandpa is over eighty and still hale and hearty.

usage.en: Mostly as a greeting, especially in the Year of the Horse.
usage.zh: 多用作祝福语，马年尤为常用。

natural: Forming factions for private gain

meaning.en: To form a clique for selfish ends.
meaning.zh: 结成小集团，谋求私利。

examples.zh: 这些官员结党营私，损害国家利益。
examples.en: These officials formed cliques for their own gain, harming the national interest.

examples.zh: 公司内部严禁结党营私。
examples.en: Factionalism is strictly prohibited in the company.

natural: The blind men and the elephant

meaning.en: To judge the whole from a part; a partial view.
meaning.zh: 比喻对事物只凭片面的了解或局部的经验，就乱加猜测，想作出全面的判断。

equivalents: the blind men and the elephant
can't see the wood for the trees

examples.zh: 只看一份报告就下结论，无异于盲人摸象。
examples.en: Drawing conclusions from one report is like the blind men and the elephant.

examples.zh: 了解一个国家不能盲人摸象。
examples.en: You can't understand a country from just one angle.

story.en: A king had blind men touch an elephant. The one who felt its tusk said it was like a radish, the ear like a winnowing basket, the leg like a pillar, the tail like a rope — each partly right, all wrong.
story.zh: 国王让盲人摸象，摸到牙的说象像萝卜，摸到耳朵的说像簸箕，摸到腿的说像柱子，摸到尾巴的说像绳子。

usage.en: Predicate or object. The same parable is well known in English.

natural: Relying on strength to bully the weak

meaning.en: To use one's strength to bully the weak.
meaning.zh: 仗着自己强大，欺负弱小。

examples.zh: 大国不应恃强凌弱。
examples.en: Big countries shouldn't bully weaker ones.

examples.zh: 校园里不能有恃强凌弱的现象。
examples.en: There must be no bullying of the weak at school.

natural: Rich and heartless

meaning.en: Rich and heartless; getting rich by unscrupulous means.
meaning.zh: 靠不正当手段发财致富的人，不会有好心肠。

examples.zh: 这个老板为富不仁，常常克扣工人工资。
examples.en: The heartless rich boss often docks his workers' wages.

examples.zh: 企业家不能为富不仁。
examples.en: Entrepreneurs mustn't be rich and heartless.

story.en: Mencius quotes Yang Hu: "Those who seek wealth will not be benevolent; those who are benevolent will not be rich" (为富不仁矣，为仁不富矣).
story.zh: 《孟子》引阳虎语："为富不仁矣，为仁不富矣。"
